title: Bitcoin Movie Enigma

prize.note: single P2WPKH escrow, one funding transaction

target_format: BIP39 24 words (English), most likely BIP84 m/84'/0'/0'/0/i (script type v0_p2wpkh), no passphrase stated

derivation.summary: identify the 34 movies shown in panel order, transform each title into an English BIP39 word, drop 10 'intruder' words identified from an IMDb metadata field, and derive the resulting 24-word mnemonic to a P2WPKH address
derivation.certified_against: the public BIP39/BIP84 test vectors (12-word and 24-word 'abandon' vectors), since no solved sibling exists for this puzzle

difficulty_note: a local brute-force run 2026-08-20 (analysis/bruteforce_solver.py + bruteforce_phase3_runall.py, run on the user's own machine, solver validated against tools/oracle.py's own check() function before and after) checked 205,263,936 real candidates against the live escrow with 0 matches: phase 1 (589,824: full word-cross under H1 with panel 8 = Goonies, panel 11 = Ace Ventura, Raiders swept across all 2048 real BIP39 words, no invented word), phase 2A (1,179,648: same plus Sharknado='tornado' as an alternative), and phase 3 (203,494,464 across 216 of 240 possible one-in/one-out swaps of H1's own 10-intruder membership, using only already-backed candidate words for the swapped-in panel; the other 24 pairs are blocked because The Shining has no backed word under the validated whole-word/singular/substring hierarchy -- 'shine' is not a literal substring of 'shining'). This is materially stronger negative evidence than before: it is no longer just the 3 gap/disputed panels left unexplained -- either one of the 15 'settled' single-candidate keeper words is itself wrong, or the director/lead-actor intruder criterion needs more than a single-panel swap to be correct. Separately still unresolved: panel 8 (Goonies primary, Shutter Island kept as a live probability, independently sourced via Bing Visual Search) and panel 11 (Ace Ventura primary per the user's own identification, evidentiary tension against Godzilla's independently-sourced beach-shipwreck scene never resolved).

tested_total.note: 0 matches across phase 1 (589,824), phase 2A (1,179,648), and the full phase-3 one-in/one-out sweep (203,494,464 across 216/240 pairs; 24 blocked, no backed word for The Shining). 794,073 + 6,891 checksum-valid candidates recorded individually (candidate_index, mnemonic, checksum_valid=true, panel word breakdown), not just counted. Wall time: phases 1+2A under a minute, phase 3 1h45m17s at ~32,000 candidates/sec, 8 worker processes.

leads.title: reconsider whether director/lead-actor repetition is the right intruder criterion at all, not just a single-panel swap of it -- 205M candidates under that assumption found nothing
find real words for Sharknado and Raiders of the Lost Ark
settle panel 8 (Goonies vs Shutter Island) and panel 11 (Godzilla vs Ace Ventura) with decisive evidence

third_party_material: the 34 movie panels are individual frames from third-party films, not original material by the author; I do not reproduce them here and link to the author's still-live site instead
